description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_URISchemeRegistry class, which manages registration and retrieval of URI scheme validator objects, acting as a registry for URI schemes within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URISchemeRegistry
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing URI scheme validator objects, including caching, registration, and retrieval based on scheme name.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the registry, optionally resetting or overriding with a provided prototype.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Retrieves a scheme validator object for a given URI scheme, creating and caching it if necessary, with configuration-based validation.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a custom URI scheme validator into the registry, bypassing reflection.
